structures_observed: Caecum and terminal ileum: source-labelled nearby landmarks
assets.caption: Source-labelled normal appendix on longitudinal ultrasound, with a 0.3 cm measurement and nearby caecum and terminal ileum markers. This still image provides a local reference; it does not demonstrate graded compressibility or the entire base-to-tip course.
assets.limitations: The original PDF embeds modest-resolution clinical figures (approximately 494 pixels wide at 150 dpi). No DICOM series, validated full course, complete attachment geometry, dynamic compression or 3D reconstruction is supplied. The source legend distinguishes psoas and rectus stars, but the star glyphs appear similar; those muscle labels cannot be independently distinguished at this resolution.
